* '''Name:''' Eldritch Card Cruncher
* '''Acquired from:''' {{Item|Classic D&D Red Box}}
* '''Minimum Level:''' 1
* '''Binding:''' {{Bind|BtA|BoA|nocat=TRUE}}
* '''Base Value:''' 10 pp
* '''Weight:''' 0.01 lbs
* ''' Description:''' 
** Functional Eldritch Card Cruncher : Use this miniature eldritch device to combine two [[Anniversary Card Collection|40th Anniversary cards]] into a prize. Each pair of cards results in a different prize. Two of the same cards cannot be combined.
** Non-functional Eldritch Card Cruncher : A non-functional miniature model of an eldritch device. It would work well as a paper weight.
